findings.summary: Program graph-inheritance-scaling cycle 1 (succession from director d41fe9b): question — as required distinct-fragment chain depth grows past the accepted frontier (>3), does inherited knowledge keep paying (memory-led success, reused>novel actions at depth >=4 under fragment and graphiter policies with V31 standard equipment) or collapse against cold/reference baselines? Team froze the full instrument set before outcomes: composites D2Q (verbatim C2 control)/D3B/D4B/D4Q/D5Q with anchored predicates and carryover-safe region logic, frozen V31 edge-equipment mapping with identical rng consumption, growth driver with MarkerSession telemetry and stop rule, gates G1/G2/G3, trap suite 14/14 green. Growth phase later verified genuine and clean by the auditor: base KB counts 14/19/13/12 → grown 16/27/15/15 with exactly the three declared 1-step fragments (books.home, quotes.home, quotes.logout) plus disclosed login revalidation; duplicate generic.paginate.next shown pre-existing in cycle-3 provenance. Contamination property independently reconfirmed (subgoal-end vectors reconstructed from raw per-action marker matrix; zero adjacent-pair violations across composites). NO scientific scaling verdict exists in this snapshot — see NEGATIVE finding.

Decisive auditor finding F5: the preregistered P2 confirmation batch (60 rows) never ran, nor did s7 dry diagnostics, s9 analysis script, s10 report or scaling_MANIFEST.json — the snapshot is an unfinished cycle with no depth-scaling claim either way. Supporting defects: F1 the binding G1 gate was computed over empty input (driver defines subgoal_ends telemetry but never wires subgoal_hook into the Explorer constructor, so 'gates_pass': true was vacuous — property itself true when recomputed from raw markers); F2 rebuild_scaling.py crashes on any use (SQL bindings mismatch; raw_json slot hardcoded NULL) so the evaluation-critical byte-restored-KB path never executed once and no test covers it; F3 one post-outcome analysis-bearing change (host-binding root predicates fixing root_b/root_q not checking host) quantified outcome-neutral by diffing preserved pre-hostfix run vs canonical rerun but must ship as labeled amendment. Verdict REVISE with RF-1..RF-6, explicit warning that SCALING-COLLAPSE/PARTIAL must ship with equal prominence and post-outcome test-weakening converts REVISE into BLOCKED.

Same enforcement-gate false positive as Physics run 32793165981, but with retry-storm economics: `git status --porcelain` flagged the 34 workflow-pre-staged control-plane sync files (.opencode agents, docs/roles, directives, intel/competitor_seed.json — staged before the auditor session) as 'Graph Auditor wrote outside audit outputs', deterministically failing every attempt. Eight audit attempts ran (~18m each), eight distinct audit-attempt branches were pushed, the LANE DIRECTOR never ran, and ~13h of wall-clock plus runner minutes were consumed re-producing an identical REVISE outcome. The auditor even read the workflow source mid-audit to understand the gate it was about to trip. Fix direction identical: scope the write check to changes made during the audit session (diff vs HEAD), or unstage plumbing before auditing.

Team-side pre-outcome hygiene find worth preserving: the frozen predicate set had a host-binding bug (root_b/root_q region checks did not verify host, e.g. a quotes URL satisfied the books-root region, visible as GQ1 satisfying D4B position 3); behaviorally inert for these site-confined tasks (explorers skip external links) but fixed pre-outcome and disclosed — then correctly flagged by the auditor under F3 as requiring amendment labeling because the fix landed after growth outcomes existed.

Team phase 59m30s; single audit ~18m; ×8 attempts ≈2h24m of audit compute plus queue/retry overhead spread over ~13h55m (created 00:25:34Z → updated 14:42:37Z). Net lane cost of the enforcement bug for this program: roughly a half-day delay plus one wasted full audit per retry. 66 stall-watch warnings in this bundle; one provider-outage retry before the attempt-8 audit started.

failure_signatures: ENFORCE_AUDIT_ONLY_FALSE_POSITIVE (recurrence #2, with retry storm): pre-staged index entries + porcelain-based write-scope gate + auto-rerun = deterministic infinite-looking retry loop; distinguishable from a genuine auditor violation only by inspecting WHO staged the entries.

VACUOUS_GATE_OVER_EMPTY_INPUT: a validity gate reported 'gates_pass': true while its binding input channel was never wired (subgoal_hook defined but not passed to Explorer) — gates must assert non-empty input denominators.
UNTESTED_EVALUATION_CRITICAL_PATH: rebuild_scaling.py (byte-restored KB per run) crashed on first real use during audit despite 'suite green' — path had zero coverage.
